mapper.select: SELECT v.voucher_date AS "entryDate", v.id AS "voucherId", v.voucher_no AS "voucherNo", v.status AS "voucherStatus", e.summary AS "summary", a.id AS "accountId", a.code AS "accountCode", a.name AS "accountName", e.debit AS "debit", e.credit AS "credit" FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE v.voucher_date >= #{begin} AND v.voucher_date <= #{end} AND e.account_id IN #{id} ORDER BY v.voucher_date, v.period, v.voucher_seq, e.seq

SELECT e.account_id AS "accountId", SUM(e.debit) AS "debit", SUM(e.credit) AS "credit", SUM(CASE WHEN e.debit <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "inCount", SUM(CASE WHEN e.credit <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "outCount" FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id WHERE v.voucher_date >= #{begin} AND v.voucher_date <= #{end} AND e.account_id IN #{id} GROUP BY e.account_id
SELECT kind AS "kind", COUNT(*) AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "amount" FROM fin_settlement WHERE voucher_id IS NULL AND status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY kind
